notes: Original style systems. Each style varies layout logic, typography treatment, background system and decoration, not only color. Font ids reference research/fonts.json, palette ids reference research/palettes.json, layout ids reference layoutCatalog below. Sizes are in px at a 1080px-wide canvas and scale proportionally.

layoutCatalog.hook-giant-type: Oversized headline filling 60-75% of the canvas, minimal subline, swipe cue bottom-right.
layoutCatalog.hook-split: Canvas split into two blocks (color or image / type); headline in one half.
layoutCatalog.hook-centered: Centered headline with small kicker above and subline below.
layoutCatalog.hook-image-overlay: Full-bleed image or graphic with gradient scrim and headline anchored bottom-left.
layoutCatalog.hook-number: Huge numeral (e.g. '7') as the visual anchor with headline beside or below.
layoutCatalog.hook-tweet: Post-style card: avatar, name, handle, text, optional metrics row.
layoutCatalog.body-top-left: Kicker + headline top-left, body below, generous whitespace right.
layoutCatalog.body-card: Content placed on a raised surface card over the background.
layoutCatalog.body-two-column: Headline left column, body right column (landscape and square only).
layoutCatalog.body-centered: Centered headline and body, symmetrical margins.
layoutCatalog.body-icon-top: Icon or illustration on top, headline, then body.
layoutCatalog.list-bullets: Headline then 3-5 bullets with custom markers.
layoutCatalog.step-big-number: Step number as giant numeral, step title, explanation.
layoutCatalog.step-timeline: Vertical timeline connecting steps with nodes.
layoutCatalog.stat-hero: One giant figure, label underneath, source line in small text.
layoutCatalog.quote-big-marks: Large quotation marks, quote text, attribution.
layoutCatalog.quote-card: Quote on a surface card with attribution row.
layoutCatalog.compare-split: Before/after or A/B in two halves with labels.
layoutCatalog.cta-centered: Centered call to action, handle, save/share icons.
layoutCatalog.cta-profile: Avatar/logo, handle, follow prompt, secondary action.
layoutCatalog.cta-recap: Short recap list followed by call to action.
layoutCatalog.diagram-cycle: 3-6 nodes around a circle joined by curved arrows (a rhythm, habit or repeating process); optional center word.
layoutCatalog.diagram-flow: Numbered process boxes joined by arrows: a row on landscape (or 2-3 steps on square), a column on portrait.
layoutCatalog.diagram-venn: 2-3 overlapping translucent circles with labels; the shared idea sits in the overlap.
layoutCatalog.diagram-pyramid: Stacked tiers, widest at the bottom, labels inside (priorities, hierarchy, foundation first).
layoutCatalog.diagram-tree: Root node with 2-5 children joined by branches: a row of cards or a vine trunk with alternating branches.
layoutCatalog.diagram-journey: Winding road with numbered milestones and labels alternating sides (a story, journey or timeline).
layoutCatalog.diagram-versus: Two contrasting panels (A vs B, or before → after) with a VS badge or arrow between them.
layoutCatalog.diagram-stairs: Ascending steps with numbered labels and a rising arrow (growth, steps of faith).

styles.name: Minimal Swiss
styles.description: Strict grid, flush-left type, large size contrast, one signal color.

styles.name: Bold Gradient
styles.description: Saturated diagonal gradients that flow across slides, heavy display type, rounded cards.

styles.name: Editorial Magazine
styles.description: Serif display headlines, kickers, drop caps, column rules and generous leading.

styles.name: Brutalist
styles.description: Raw blocks, thick borders, hard shadows, all-caps mono or grotesk, intentionally loud.

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.description: Blurred mesh-gradient backdrop with frosted translucent panels and soft glow.

styles.name: Neo-Pop
styles.description: Flat saturated color, chunky outlines, stickers, offset shadows, playful rotation.

styles.name: Corporate Clean
styles.description: Calm, trustworthy layouts with a brand bar, icons, and clear data presentation.

styles.name: Dark Tech
styles.description: Dark UI, monospace accents, code-window frames, glowing neon highlights, dot grid.

styles.name: Pastel Soft
styles.description: Gentle pastels, rounded shapes, airy spacing, soft shadows and organic blobs.

styles.name: Retro Print
styles.description: Risograph-inspired grain, offset color layers, condensed display type and halftones.

styles.name: Hand-drawn Notes
styles.description: Notebook paper, handwritten accents, marker highlights, doodled arrows and circles.

styles.name: Data / Infographic
styles.description: Chart-first slides, big numbers, labeled axes, iconography and source footnotes.

styles.name: Quote Card
styles.description: One idea per slide: centered statement, oversized quote marks, attribution, lots of air.

styles.name: Tweet-style
styles.description: Each slide reads like a short social post: avatar, name, handle, plain text, white space.

styles.name: Step-by-step Tutorial
styles.description: Numbered steps with progress tracker, icon per step, clear instruction blocks.

styles.name: Luxury Serif
styles.description: Dark or blush grounds, fine serif type, wide tracking on small caps, thin gold lines.

styles.name: Panoramic Flow
styles.description: One continuous illustration/gradient band and connecting line run across every slide so swiping feels seamless.

styles.name: Neo-Retro Grid
styles.description: Synthwave-adjacent perspective grid, chrome-free gradients, condensed caps, outline type.

styles.name: Minimalism
styles.description: Generous white space, one quiet accent, light-weight type and almost nothing else.

styles.name: Maximalism
styles.description: More is more: loud color clashes, stacked heavy type, patterns, stickers and confetti shapes.

styles.name: Surreal
styles.description: Dreamlike gradients, floating lit spheres, an arched portal and a soft serif with an italic twist.

styles.name: Swiss Design
styles.description: International Typographic Style: visible column grid, huge tight grotesk, a red circle and flush-left text.

styles.name: Editorial
styles.description: Newspaper masthead, display serif headlines, italic emphasis, double rules and paper grain.

styles.name: Paper
styles.description: Layered paper-cut hills with real drop shadows, a cut-out sun and soft paper texture.

styles.name: Clay
styles.description: Puffy claymorphism: rounded type, soft pastel shapes lit from the top-left, pillowy cards with deep soft shadows.

styles.name: Vector Art
styles.description: Flat vector illustration: rolling hills, sun and clouds, geometric shapes, bold geometric sans.

styles.name: Handwritten
styles.description: Bullet-journal page: dot grid, red margin line, felt-tip handwriting, tape, paper clip and doodles.

styles.name: Graffiti
styles.description: Street wall: spray-painted marker lettering with glow, paint drips, splats and a concrete texture.

styles.name: Scripture
styles.description: Reverent verse cards: classic serif, ivory paper, double frame, ornament dividers, generous space for the Word.

styles.name: Stained Glass
styles.description: Jewel-toned glass panes with dark leading, light streaming down, engraved capitals.

styles.name: Parchment
styles.description: Aged parchment, sepia ink, inscribed capitals and flourishes — like an old letter or scroll.

styles.name: Sunday Light
styles.description: Warm, welcoming church-social look: soft light rays, friendly sans, clear points, gentle illustrations.

styles.name: Illustrated Story
styles.description: Picture-book carousel: a friendly illustration on most slides — characters, scenes and symbols drawn for the topic.

styles.name: Night Prayer
styles.description: Quiet night sky, twinkling stars and a warm candle glow; elegant serif for prayers and evening devotions.

styles.name: Bible Story Comic
styles.description: Story told in comic panels: a drawn scene with characters on every slide and a caption box — great for Bible stories and testimonies.
